data.name: Bahishti
data.gender_notes: Bahishti is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Bahisht' which means 'Gardens of Paradise'. In Islamic belief, the term is used to describe the beautiful gardens of heaven, prepared for the righteous. The name Bahishti carries the meaning “Gardens of Paradise” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bahishti usually hope their child will grow to embody gardens of paradise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of paradise and eternal beauty, bestowed upon those who lead a righteous life.
data.etymology: Bahishti belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gardens of Paradise.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bahishti total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: بہشتی

in_urdu.name: بہشتی
in_urdu.meaning: جنت سے متعلق، جنت کی نشانی، یا جنت میں رہنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: بہشتی نام کا مطلب ہے جنت سے متعلق، جنت کی نشانی، یا جنت میں رہنے والا۔ یہ نام اہل سنت کی روایات میں جنت کی خوبیوں اور خوشیوں کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ اس نام کی اصیل عربی جڑیں ہیں اور یہ اسلامی دنیا میں بڑے احترام کے ساتھ استعمال ہوتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: बहिश्ती
in_hindi.meaning: स्वर्ग से संबंधित, स्वर्ग का निवासी
in_hindi.long_meaning: बहिश्ती नाम का अर्थ है स्वर्ग से संबंधित, स्वर्ग का निवासी या स्वर्ग में रहने वाला। यह नाम जन्नत की विशेषताओं और खुशियों को प्रकट करता है, जो इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्वपूर्ण मानी जाती हैं। इस नाम की जड़ें अरबी भाषा में हैं और यह इस्लामी दुनिया भर में बहुत सम्मान के साथ प्रयोग किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: بھشتى
in_pashto.meaning: د جنت سره تړاو، د جنت نښه، یا په جنت کې اوسیدونکی
in_pashto.long_meaning: بھشتى نوم معنی دى د جنت سره تړاو، د جنت نښه، یا په جنت کې اوسیدونکی. دا نوم د جنت د ښېګڼو او خوښو څرګندولو لپاره کارول کېږي، کوم چې د اسلامي دود په کې ډېر مهم ګڼل کېږي. د دې نوم اصل عربي ريښې لري او د اسلامي نړۍ کې د ډېر احترام سره کارول کېږي.

in_english.meaning: Paradise-related, heavenly, or inhabitant of Paradise
in_english.long_meaning: The name Bahishti is derived from the Arabic word 'Bahsh', meaning paradise or heaven. It signifies someone who is related to or inhabits paradise. In Islamic tradition, this name reflects the beauty and joy of paradise. With its roots in Arabic, the name Bahishti is used with respect across the Islamic world.
